observations: Black game console with a vertical slot on the right side, characteristic of a PlayStation 4 Slim.
One black DualShock 4 controller is placed on top.
The console and controller are wrapped in clear plastic film.
The console is sitting on a wooden surface.
A watermark 'PHILIP CHIEMELA' is visible across the center of the images.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the software version and connection status.

Video of the controller being used to navigate the system menu.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
